variable_coverage.construction: Source formula: R_{t+i} = firm 12-month buy-and-hold return including dividends − buy-and-hold return of the assigned size-decile portfolio; i ∈ {1,2,3}. Source definition: Twelve-month size-adjusted buy-and-hold return, including dividends, for horizon i = 1, 2, or 3. Size adjustment subtracts the buy-and-hold return of the firm’s assigned size portfolio. The return window begins at the start of the fourth month after fiscal year-end; size portfolios are formed from NYSE/AMEX firms ranked into deciles by beginning-of-year market value of equity, and sample firms are assigned by their beginning-of-year equity value. Raw component fields: CRSP.MSF: PERMNO, PERMCO, DATE, RET, RETX, PRC, SHROUT, VOL, CUSIP; CRSP.DSENAMES: PERMNO, NAMEDT, NAMEENDT, SHRCD, EXCHCD, SICCD, CUSIP, NCUSIP, TICKER; CRSP.CCMXPF_LINKTABLE: gvkey, lpermno, linkdt, linkenddt, linkprim, linktype, liid Preserve raw missing values and denominators; do not impute missing source components or force an observed classification.

Source formula: C_t = 1 if Accruals_t < 0 and Revision_t > 0, or Accruals_t > 0 and Revision_t < 0; 0 otherwise. Whether C is subsequently portfolio-rank scaled is unclear. Source definition: Year-t indicator for consistent accrual and analyst forecast-revision signals about low earnings persistence: one when Accruals_t is negative and the consensus forecast for year t+1 is revised upward around the year-t earnings announcement, or Accruals_t is positive and that forecast is revised downward; zero otherwise. Accruals uses the paper’s total-accrual measure: Accruals are [(change in current assets − change in cash and cash equivalents) − (change in current liabilities − change in debt included in current liabilities) − depreciation and amortization expense], scaled by average total assets. The paper’s general rank-scaling statement does not clarify whether this binary indicator is rank-scaled. Raw component fields: COMP.FUNDA: gvkey, datadate, fyear, fyr, sich, act, che, lct, dlc, dp, at, sale, seq, ceq, txditc, ib, ni, mkvalt, prcc_f, csho; CRSP.MSF: PERMNO, PERMCO, DATE, RET, RETX, PRC, SHROUT, VOL, CUSIP; IBES.STATSUM_EPSUS: TICKER, CUSIP, STATPERS, MEASURE, FISCALP, FPI, NUMEST, MEANEST, MEDEST, FPEDATS, USFIRM; WRDSAPPS.IBCRSPHIST: TICKER, PERMNO, sdate, edate, ncusip, SCORE; CRSP.CCMXPF_LINKTABLE: gvkey, lpermno, linkdt, linkenddt, linkprim, linktype, liid Preserve raw missing values and denominators; do not impute missing source components or force an observed classification.

Source formula: RAccruals_t = year-t accrual-portfolio rank scaled to [0,1], where Accruals is Accruals_t = [(ΔCA_t − ΔCash_t) − (ΔCL_t − ΔSTD_t) − Dep_t] / average total assets_t, where ΔCA is change in current assets, ΔCash is change in cash/cash equivalents, ΔCL is change in current liabilities, ΔSTD is change in debt included in current liabilities, and Dep is depreciation and amortization expense. Source definition: Year-t rank of the accrual portfolio, scaled to the zero-to-one range. The ranked quantity is the paper’s total Accruals measure: Accruals are [(change in current assets − change in cash and cash equivalents) − (change in current liabilities − change in debt included in current liabilities) − depreciation and amortization expense], scaled by average total assets. Raw component fields: COMP.FUNDA: gvkey, datadate, fyear, fyr, sich, act, che, lct, dlc, dp, at, sale, seq, ceq, txditc, ib, ni, mkvalt, prcc_f, csho Preserve raw missing values and denominators; do not impute missing source components or force an observed classification.

Source formula: C_RAccruals_t = C_t × RAccruals_t; any additional portfolio-rank scaling is not specified. Source definition: Year-t interaction equal to the product of the consistent-signal indicator C_t and the year-t accrual-portfolio rank RAccruals_t. evidence.quote: Future returns, Rtþi, are twelve-month size-adjusted buy-and-hold returns, inclusive of dividends.
To size-adjust a firm’s return, we subtract from the firm’s buy-and-hold return the buy-and-hold return to its size-matched portfolio.

To calculate this adjustment, we rank all sample firms that are traded on the New York Stock Exchange (NYSE) and American Stock Exchange (AMEX) into 10 portfolios based on market value of equity at the beginning of the year.
We then assign each sample firm to one of the portfolios based on the firm’s market value of equity at the beginning of the year and calculate the buy-and-hold return for each size portfolio.

As with all of our tests, i ranges from one to three.
Specifically, for each of the 10 accrual portfolios we identify firms as having consistent signals when Accruals is negative (positive) and Revision is positive (negative).

An observation is included in the consistent signals subsample if the mean consensus analyst forecast for year t þ 1 is revised upward (downward) in the month of the year t earnings announcement and year t accruals are negative (positive); otherwise it is included in the inconsistent signals subsample.
C is an indicator variable that equals one for firms with accruals and analyst forecast revisions that are consistent in indicating low earnings persistence, and zero otherwise.
